Which statement is correct?
A
The acceleration of an object is calculated using the area under a distance–time graph.
B
The acceleration of an object is calculated using the gradient of a speed–time graph.
C
The speed of an object is calculated using the area under a distance–time graph.
D
The speed of an object is calculated using the gradient of a speed–time graph.
